findings.quote: **Collective nouns** such as *team*, *family*, and *committee* can be treated as a unit or as their individual members. Singular agreement is especially common in American English when the group is viewed as one unit ("The team *is* practicing"). Plural agreement is more common in British English and can also emphasize individual members ("The team *are* arguing among themselves"). Use the meaning and the variety/style expected in the passage.
